meta.title: CELTIC Diekirch
meta.description: Athletics and triathlon in Diekirch. Records, training, groups and fixtures of CELTIC Diekirch, founded in 1968.

events.leadNordstadsemi: The Foyer Nordstadlaf is the road race of CELTIC Diekirch. It is run over the half marathon distance of 21.1 km, alongside a 10 km and a 5 km race. Start and finish are in Diekirch.
events.leadEurocross: The Eurocross is the cross-country race of CELTIC Diekirch, held together with the Eurotail. It is run late in the year in Diekirch.

training.groupsIntro: Which group you join depends on age, but we also look at development. The transitions between groups are fluid.
training.schoolNote: The athletics school prepares for every sport in the club: athletics, triathlon and duathlon. That is where the two sections meet.
training.noHoliday: We do not take holidays. Training is only cancelled on official public holidays.
training.triNote: The triathlon section is separate, with its own coaches.
